name: Refined season comparison on phone
prompt: Keep reference image 1's exact narrow portrait canvas and shared Farls da bag / Sample stats / Menu header. Replace every element below that header with the refined season-comparison content in reference image 2. No profile crest, career metrics or timeline. A 390-by-900 CSS-pixel phone viewport, edge to edge, 16-pixel side margins. Compact heading 2024 with year chevron and Season records link. Beneath it show Champion Sample rival and Runner-up Sample manager as two quiet linked facts, then a closed disclosure labeled only Season format. Local tabs Standings selected, Matchups, Playoffs, Players, all at readable phone size. Adapt the comparison table into unboxed divided manager rows, not a compressed desktop grid. Each row begins with rank and manager on the left, record on the right; below that show Scoring vs league with its value, then Wins vs expected with its value. First row: 1, Sample manager, 10–4, +24.0%, +0.7. Second: 2, Sample rival, 9–5, +14.3%, -0.2. Third: 3, Sample manager C, 8–6, +7.1%, -0.7. Further rows continue below the viewport. Keep ordinary text 16 pixels, dark data ink, restrained weights, violet selected navigation and actions, natural line wrapping, and quiet separators. No metric banners, player highlights, footer summaries, visible format-statistics strip, avatars, cards, source calculations, operational status or update dates. All results are fictional.
